strict_selector_fiber: if nonempty, affine over Hom_G(Y,ker d1)
relative_selector_class_fiber: after representative-change 2-cells, affine over Hom_G(Y,H1) where H1=ker d1/im d2
typing_rule: Strict chain ambiguity and invariant relative-class ambiguity are distinct and must never share one dimension field.
completion_extension: Completed selection requires a compatible point in the inverse system of relative selector-class torsors plus chain-level coherent representatives when strict output is claimed.
